title: Hosted API geo-stewardship: region pinset orchestration, retention profiles, and automated evidence flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Provide a hosted-API feature that lets tenants declare and enforce preferred region sets (pinsets) at the endpoint and tenant level, attach retention profiles, and produce verifiable evidence bundles for audits. This ticket scopes orchestration (policy DSL + UI), request routing primitives, retention lifecycle hooks, and evidence packaging for periodic export. Goal: enable compliance teams to assert where requests and retained artifacts are stored and for how long, with deterministic fallbacks and an auditable evidence trail.
acceptance_criteria: API: New tenant-level and endpoint-level pinset config endpoints available in the Redwood Admin API (CRUD).
Routing: Requests annotated with tenant pinset must be routed to matching regional capacity; if unavailable fall back to preconfigured compatible regions per policy.
Retention: Retention profiles can be bound to pinsets and specify retention TTL, deletion workflow, and export retention metadata.
Evidence: Automated evidence bundles (snapshot + metadata + signed manifest) are generated on schedule and on-demand for a tenant, and exportable via admin API.
UI: Console has a Pinset editor with validation, retention binding, and preview of affected endpoints.
Telemetry: New metrics emitted (pinset_match_rate, pinset_fallback_rate, evidence_generation_success).
Audit: Evidence bundle contains request counts, region placements, retention actions, and is cryptographically signed by KMS/HSM.
notes: Design decision 2025-02-08: use a small declarative DSL for pinset policies (allow/deny lists + fallback_order + residency_assertion_level).
Engineering notes 2025-02-11: routing will reuse existing smart-routing layer; need extension to prefer capacity by region tag and to track per-request placement for evidence.
Retention edge case: short TTL (<=24h) must still appear in evidence bundles with deletion proof (tombstone event).
Security: KMS/HSM signing will be handled by infra team; evidence manifest format to align with release hosted-2025.04 schema.
